canonicalPath: createNewCareerState -> startProductionMatch -> advanceProductionMatch (10000 ticks, stopAtHalf=false) -> resultFromSession
sampleDesign: Fixed save seeds; manager clubs rotate through real-world competition clubs; first actual league fixture; actual career snapshot ratings/availability/lineup; CPU coach active for opponent and manual manager defaults unchanged; no live commands in distribution sample.

definitions.possessions: Canonical ledger attacks (live touched possessions); procedural fragments excluded; per-team counts use ledger ownership.
definitions.duration: Recorded possession first-to-last event official span; excludes stopped clock. Simulation span also reported. A trace-span observation, not independently reconstructed wall-clock possession duration.
definitions.turnover: nonShotLoss is the canonical ledger count lost without any shot; turnoverEndings mirrors resultFromSession lossClassOf-ending count and can include a prior shot.
definitions.saves: SAVE_CAUGHT + SAVE_PARRY; savePctOnTarget = saves/(saves+goals); saveShareAllAttempts also explicit.
definitions.transition: Shot phase comes from canonical SHOT_RELEASED.details.phase; transitionPossessionsObserved requires a phase-bearing event, so possession transitions without such events are not counted.
definitions.shotDistance: Euclidean recorded release location to goal centre; local coordinates invert with actual PERIOD_STARTED event and team.
definitions.shooterPosition: role/shooterPositions is immutable initial MatchPerson position (starter slot or bench original role), consistently paired with baseline. tacticalRole/shooterTacticalPositions additionally follows actual chronological EXCHANGE_COMPLETED role assignments in post-baseline runs.
definitions.originControl: Post-baseline diagnostics compare each shot release origin with the original same-tick observed shooter frame, allowing 0.9m for the 0.86m physical catch offset plus centimetre quantization. Missing exact-tick frames are explicitly unavailable. Chunk-boundary actual controller snapshots check 0.86m exclusive on-court control; this is not a claim of every-tick invariant coverage.
definitions.scorerConcentration: Top scorer goal share and Herfindahl sum of squared scorer goal shares, computed per team then averaged.
definitions.references: Existing core/realism.ts EHF_ELITE wide engineering plausibility bands, not sourced empirical league targets. Allsvenskan sample is not automatically elite European club calibration.

unavailableMetrics: A separate catch-quality rating or intended shot-quality scalar is not recorded in baseline event data; newer release details are retained when present.
This event-reading benchmark does not count transition attempts lacking a phase-bearing event; observed transition possessions and released transition shots are reported.
The baseline benchmark did not retain a separate semantic first-threat classifier; first live release latency is retained per possession and post-baseline causal action windows remain available.
